program: Business Finland Sprint grant (Sprint-avustus, continuous call from 1.9.2026), which replaced the closed Tempo
next_step_program: Business Finland Research, development and piloting funding (Tutkimus, kehitys ja pilotointi / T&K-rahoitus)
stopper_list: 1. Tempo is closed and will not reopen; its replacement is the Sprint grant, open continuously from 1.9.2026 (https://www.businessfinland.fi/en/whats-new/news/2026/what-do-business-finlands-funding-services-look-like-at-the-beginning-of-2026/ ; https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/)

2. RULES THE FOUNDER OUT: Sprint cannot go to a company under 5 years old that was earlier granted Sprint, Tempo or equivalent incubator funding such as ESA-BIC, Business Finland R&D funding, Young Innovative Companies or Deep Tech Accelerator. The target group is also limited to startups with no earlier Business Finland funding, and ESA BIC incubation funding is itself Business Finland funding (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/ ; https://www.businessfinland.fi/en/services/funding/calls/2026/esa-bic-incubation-funding-spring-2026/)

3. Same-solution bar at any age: if any listed funding, ESA-BIC included, went to the same solution, Sprint stays barred after age 5. Companies 5 or older also need a significant innovation-based change of direction, so waiting until 15.3.2028 does not help (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/)

4. Register in My Business Finland, fill in the background information and hold the expert discussion before submitting (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/)

5. Applicant must be a Finnish osakeyhtiö with a Y-tunnus operating in Finland; no sole traders or partnerships (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/ ; https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

6. Small enterprise: under 50 persons and turnover or balance sheet total of at most 10 MEUR; linked and partner enterprises count (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/)

7. At least 50,000 EUR of equity financing on the balance sheet (share capital, SVOP, capital loans; money already spent counts; a signed investment commitment can count) (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/)

8. Net financial assets of 63,334 EUR (under 5 years) or 133,334 EUR for a full project, plus cash for the company's other costs (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/)

9. Team of at least 2 committed people working in Finland, at least 1 full time in the company (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/ ; https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

10. Project of 100,000-133,334 EUR at a 75% grant rate, at least 2/3 R&D plus customer and market validation; no sales, marketing or operations (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/)

11. De minimis quota must not be exceeded: 300,000 EUR over any 3 years, with group aid added together (https://www.businessfinland.fi/globalassets/finnish-customers/01-funding/08-guidelines--terms/funding-terms/sprint-avustuksen_rahoitusehdot.pdf)

12. Not an undertaking in difficulty: a company 3 years or older that has lost more than half its subscribed share capital through accumulated losses is barred, checked at decision time and also mid-year; applies to both programs (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/rahoituspalvelut/ohjeet-ehdot-ja-lomakkeet/vaikeuksissa-oleva-yritys/ ; https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

13. General barriers: in the prepayment register, beneficial-owner notification filed, financial statements filed with PRH and audited as the law requires, no overdue taxes (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/rahoituspalvelut/ohjeet-ehdot-ja-lomakkeet/vaikeuksissa-oleva-yritys/)

14. Sprint mandatory attachments: project plan on the BF template, shareholder list, account-level income statement and balance sheet at most 2 months old covering the current financial year (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/)

15. Only a person in the trade register with sole power to represent the company, or a holder of the Suomi.fi mandate 'Yritysrahoituksen hakeminen', can create the application (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/ ; https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

16. No binding orders or contracts before the application is pending, and costs count only from then; Sprint purchases of 60,000 EUR or more (VAT 0) must be competitively tendered (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/jatkuva-sprint-rahoitushaku/ ; https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

17. NEXT STEP T&K: the funding form follows the content. A grant of at most 50% for SMEs is only for research projects; development and piloting get a loan of 50% (70% with justification) (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

18. NEXT STEP T&K: credible total financing plan. The company pre-finances costs, payment is in arrears except a 30% loan advance, and 10% of a grant or 20% of a loan is paid only after the final report is approved (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

19. NEXT STEP T&K: sales and marketing are not eligible; exploitation preparation is capped at 20% and test marketing at 20% (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

20. NEXT STEP T&K attachments: application form, project plan form, company background form, income statement and balance sheet at most 2 months old, monthly cash-flow forecast and annual result and financing forecast on the BF templates (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

21. NEXT STEP T&K: projects that would be carried out anyway without public funding are not funded (incentive effect) (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

22. NEXT STEP T&K: a pilot at the customer's premises is eligible only if it is not a commercial delivery and the customer does not fund the project (https://www.businessfinland.fi/palvelut/rahoitus/haut/2026/tutkimus-kehitys-ja-pilotointi/)

A: De minimis 'at most 225,000 EUR in 3 years' (turn 1 checklist): no official page prints it. The Sprint terms state a 300,000 EUR ceiling; 225,000 equals that ceiling minus the 75,000 EUR minimum grant, so it is consistent but unexplained
